[june 15th to 19th](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/41357897962903-june-2026-release-notes#h_01KVGRN81S3NXAEFCBCQMMJ6ZR) 4. [june 1st to 5th](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/41357897962903-june-2026-release-notes#h_01KVGR7M1KFN3K6TCTMGJ4E5X8) These release notes summarize the **new features, latest updates, and bug fixes** from this month in Neostella platform. For detailed information of product-specific changes, please **visit our Help Center articles.** ## june 30th ### adoption | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | Internal improvements to the migration and mapping experience, including boolean field casting (1/0 to Yes/No), removal of the conditional option from the field list, an adjusted execution button, and prefetching of mapping and execution data. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed an issue causing multiple instances to be created for a single object. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed missing fields on Tasks. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed migrated area tasks being inaccessible in production due to missing permissions. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed provisioning endpoints returning 500 errors. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed a field condition persisting after deleting and re-adding a field in a mapping. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed the Create button being enabled when required fields were empty in the new mapping form. | ### ai | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **AI Search Bracket Notation and Operator Support**
AI search now supports bracket notation and all operators when searching for persons and organizations. | ### automations | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Create Note Action (Leads & Projects)**
New automation actions allow workflows to automatically create notes and associate them with relevant records, documents, tags, and users. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Update Note Action**
Workflows can now automatically modify existing notes, including their content, metadata, and associated records. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Assign Users & Roles (Leads & Projects)**
New actions let workflows automatically assign one or more users, along with their roles, to a lead or project. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Manage Record Tags (Link/Unlink)**
New action allows workflows to automatically add or remove tags from records. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Merge Documents Action**
Combine multiple DOCX files into a single consolidated document directly within an automation workflow. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Delete Document Action**
Automatically soft-delete documents using a document ID. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Rename Document Action**
New action to rename a document as part of a workflow. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Rule Builder "Change" Operation**
Starting rules can now filter on "Is changed," e.g. "Start this automation only if: X field Is changed." | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Update Date Action**
Now supports date-only fields. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed the Dynamic Output option being available for fields that can't consume the expected data structure. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed selected roles persisting in an invalid state after changing Object Type. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed a Runner Service failure when action inputs have no datatype defined. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed loop review and debug behavior in the Control Node. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed the Related Object Record ID dropdown returning instances from all projects instead of the selected one. | ### communications | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Fax Capabilities:**
Full fax support added — receive inbound faxes, send outbound faxes (with or without a cover page), view incoming/outgoing faxes, and automatically use a contact's fax number when sending. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Automatic Calendar-to-Record Linking**
When a synced calendar event includes a Project or Lead email account as an attendee, the platform now automatically links the event to the matching record. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Folder-Based Attachment Selection**
Attachments for Email, SMS, and Notes can now be selected directly through folders. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Integration User Support**
Comms capabilities (Activity Feed, Notifications, Notes, Calendar, Email, SMS) now support Integration Users. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Disallowed File Extensions Disabled**
File types that aren't allowed are now shown as disabled in the attachment picker. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Consistent Tag Placement**
Notes and Calendar now use the standard tag placement behavior. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Attachment Redirection for Notes**
Attachment redirection is now allowed when a note was created by a different user, while edit access remains restricted. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed incorrect nested array documentation for Calendar Event API attendees and tags. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed the Calendar Events API rejecting array input for object\_type despite documenting it as an array. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed Outlook calendar sync not reflecting event updates across calendars after modification. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed template search not returning results. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed an error after clicking "Connect to Microsoft." | ### core | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Configurable Object Headers**
Admins can now configure header fields independently for Projects, Leads, and Contacts, choosing fields from that object's schema and defining their order. Each object type ships with sensible defaults (e.g., Stage, Project, Client for Projects). | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Responsive Header Display**
Record headers show as many configured fields as fit the screen width, with any overflow accessible through a new drawer that follows the same display rules as the main header. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Header Configuration Preview**
Configuring header fields now shows a live preview of the change. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed the Reports "Clear" button returning a 400/500 error. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed an error when updating a newly created group. | ### customization | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Automatic Document Linking After Generation**
Administrators can configure a destination field on document generation buttons so generated documents are automatically linked to the correct place in a record, with real-time updates delivered via WebSocket. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Tags on Contacts and Custom Objects**
Users can now add tags during contact creation, and add, remove, and view tags on custom object records. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Contextual Terminology**
Generic labels like "Context Type" and "Object Type" are now replaced with terminology aligned to the operational entity being configured. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Address Sub-Field Improvements**
Refined structure and behavior of Address field sub-fields for clearer, more consistent data entry. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Resolved a set of issues affecting Forms, Views, and Objects, including: duplicated Tags section on Contacts, a project type unavailable after migration, a Kafka schema-update event issue in QA, an incorrect "Discard Changes" prompt, a 400 error when removing primary email/phone on People records, parentship relation errors on record open/close, disabled and unreadable fields when adding a Logic Rule, inconsistent singular/plural object naming in Schema > Data, non-clickable relationship fields on Global Objects, a toolbox button overflow in Filter Fields panel, Logic Rule errors when setting email/address/period/deadline/phone field values, outdated schema JSON after migration, missing phone/email display for Organization records, a project load timeout with a large number of permission objects, and a horizontal scroll issue in Views with many components. | ### documents | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Envelope Generation via DocGen**
Generating a document from a template with Signature Fields now produces a full envelope, dispatches signature requests to signers in the correct order, and provides a complete signing experience for internal and external signers, with status reflected in the Envelopes Grid. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Full Signature Field Visibility**
Reviewers in Single Page View and signers in the signing experience can now see all signature fields, their status, and who's responsible for them — not just their own. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Envelope Details Panel**
Clicking an envelope now opens a side panel with Documents and Activity tabs, plus persistent actions to replace a signer or send a reminder email. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Mailroom Auto-Cleanup**
Documents are automatically removed from the Mailroom tab once assigned to a project. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Upload Documents from a Task**
Documents can now be uploaded directly from a task and are automatically linked to it. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Signer Notifications & History**
New signers now receive an email with their signature request, and signer replacements are now tracked in the document's signature history. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed a 3–4 second delay in drag-and-drop file uploads. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed envelope sending taking 5–10 seconds instead of the expected 2–3. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed incorrect envelope expiry date and signer defaults. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed inconsistent folder trees across Project, Contact, and Lead workspace types. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed incorrect grammar in the success message shown when multiple documents are uploaded. | ### explore | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Persistent Sort Order for Reports & Executions**
Sort By configuration is now preserved across report executions, scheduled reports, and downloads, ensuring consistent ordering even if the report definition changes later. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Improved Field Selection in Advanced Search**
Field search is now more contextual and intuitive, reducing noise when common field names like "name" or "status" would otherwise return excessive results. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Aligned Report Columns**
Default report columns now automatically match the fields shown in Advanced Search results. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed the Reports Schedules tab: name filtering, column sorting, and duplicate rows. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed filters not being applied to global view chart components. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed Advanced Search returning no results for dropdown/radio button fields. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed the Task report showing "No Data Available" despite valid search results. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed Chart components being creatable without a required "Group by" field, and requiring re-selection of chart type to enable Save. | ### finance | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Finance Workspace**
New dedicated workspace for Finance. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Finance Permissions**
Initial implementation of granular Finance permissions. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed Invoice Read-Only permissions not restricting invoice actions and editable fields. | ### intake | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed Lead Views redirection not working correctly. | ## june 22th to 26th ### adoption | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Import Time and Billing**
Ability to migrate financial and billing data as part of the migration process. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Stage Values Across All Object Types**
Users can now map legacy stages into all available Stage options across Object Types when configuring value alignment during data import. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Link Hashtags in Note Bodies to Existing Tenant Tags**
Hashtags inside migrated note bodies are now automatically matched against existing tenant tags, and notes are associated with those tags when an exact match is found. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Validate Selected Mapping Before Execution**
Ensures the selected mappings remain aligned with the current data import before execution begins. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Contact Type Mapping and Target Object Type Prioritization**
Contacts are now mapped and migrated into the most relevant object type based on contact type configurations. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed invalid timestamps displayed on Notes after migration. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed missing spaces when processing line breaks in Notes short descriptions. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed execution record counts not reflecting the primary imported object. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed "Populate from Options" incorrectly pre-filling source values when no exact match exists. | ### automations | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Webhook Trigger from External Systems**
Users can now trigger automations directly from external systems through secure webhook endpoints. This enhancement enables event-driven workflows by allowing third-party applications and integrations to start automations automatically when external events occur. The release includes webhook authentication through Integration Users, automation and provider validation, payload field mapping for workflow consumption, and asynchronous execution to support scalable integrations. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **List Projects Action**
A new List Projects automation action allows platform users to retrieve project records accessible to the authenticated user. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **NULL Origin to Clear Field Values**
A new NULL origin type within automation field configuration allows users to explicitly remove existing values from target records during automation execution. When NULL is selected as the field origin, the system will interpret it as a request to clear the field value. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Dynamic Dropdown Resolution for Stages Field**
Improved field handling for Create and Update actions now adds support for Stage fields as dynamic dropdowns. Instead of requiring users to enter stage values manually, the platform automatically retrieves available stage options from the corresponding endpoint. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Nested automation starting rule consumes Context ID**
Internal improvement that does not impact the user experience. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed variables being cleared when the page is refreshed. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed filter values being reset when multiple items are added in action configurations. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed number field filters using "contains" string matching instead of exact numeric comparison. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed action failure ("Null value passed to a required input") when Object Type is selected in filters. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed non-user-friendly error when Numeric origin is used in list actions. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed non-user-friendly error when filters are left empty in list actions. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed UI breaking when multi-select and Relationship List fields origin is switched to Null. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed missing hint message when a field origin is set to Null. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed Null origin on Object Type causing execute-method failure. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed special fields returning as 'NoneType' and causing node failures. | ### communications | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Outbound Email via Microsoft Account with Attachments**
Users can now send emails directly from their Microsoft account, including file attachments. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed incorrect exception message displayed when deleting a grant. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed user email not being visible in the Email Drawer list. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed SMS character enforcement — users could send messages over 1,600 characters that were not visible in the UI. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed UI for the Email Template delete confirmation modal. | ### core | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Recycle Bin — View and Restore Deleted Records**
Users can now view and restore deleted records from a dedicated Recycle Bin, allowing them to recover data removed by mistake. Restoration is supported both individually and in bulk, returning items to their original location. If the original parent no longer exists, the system will prompt the user to select a new destination. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Tenant ID Included in Webhook Svix Response**
The Tenant ID is now included in the Webhook Svix response payload, allowing receiving systems to identify and attribute incoming webhook events to the correct tenant. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Contextual Object Webhooks — Feature Flag Removed**
Contextual object data can now be used to trigger webhooks, rules, and external automations without requiring a feature flag. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Archived Records via Filter (no separate tab)**
Archived records are now accessible directly within the main object list through a new Archive filter, replacing the previous separate "Archived" tab. Users can filter by Active, Archived, or All records. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed user not being properly created in the Tenant DB. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed client filter selection remaining after using the CLEAR button. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed User Management name sorting not working alphabetically. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed users being able to select the same client twice in a filter. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed CCK being unable to select the type field for custom objects in workflow conditions. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed missing Canada from the global settings country list. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed pinned task being covered by the form save bar. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed contact card header showing organization name in sentence case instead of preserving original casing. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed delete icon in dynamic fields not working. | ### customization | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Leads as a Secondary Context for Project-based Objects**
Administrators can associate objects configured under the Projects context with a secondary Leads context, allowing those objects to appear and be used within Lead operational experiences. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Support Calculated Fields on Views**
Calculated fields can now be displayed in views as read-only, so administrators can surface them where end users work. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Support Fields That Can Only Be Updated via API**
Fields can now be configured as API-only updatable, enabling automations or integrations to store calculated values while keeping them read-only in the UI. This enables calculated fields derived from multiple objects. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Object Type Field — Configurable Visibility and Protected from Removal**
The Object Type field in forms is now protected from accidental removal while administrators can control whether it is visible to end users. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Field Type Dropdown Sorted Alphabetically**
Field types in the object builder are now displayed in alphabetical order, reducing friction during configuration. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Delete Row Column in Table Components**
A dedicated delete row action column is now available in Table components within forms and dynamic layouts. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904172055) | **Grid Toolbar Visibility Configuration**
Administrators can now configure whether the grid toolbar is visible in Table components within views, enabling a cleaner user experience. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed collection conflict returning a generic 500 error instead of a proper 409 error. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed workflow dropdown not being sorted alphabetically in component creation. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed radio button field options being forced into sentence case. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed generic error when saving a field with a restricted word as its name. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed generic error when saving a dropdown field without options. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357897959447) | Fixed inability to set the Context field to not visible in forms. | ### documents | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Use a Single Page for Context/Source Selection in WAI**
Consolidates context and source selection into a single page in the Word Add-In, reducing navigation friction during template configuration. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Add Relationship Fields to Tables in WAI**
Users can select relationship fields from the context and map them as table columns, so related records and their field values are expanded and populated at document generation time. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Enabling Address Subfields Inserted in WAI**
Users can insert each address subfield independently as its own field tag, allowing precise control over document layout and formatting. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Retrieving Context Roles within the WAI**
Users can browse the roles available in the context, expand them to see their person fields, and insert those fields as tags directly into the document. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Add Tags to the Settings Tab in the WAI**
Tags defined in the Settings tab are now stored as part of the template configuration and automatically applied to generated documents. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Setting Total Sum as a Reusable Variable**
Users can define a column's total sum as a named reusable variable for reuse elsewhere in the document, such as narrative paragraphs or signature blocks. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Adding Total Sum on Tables**
Columns can be marked as summable so the platform automatically calculates and inserts column totals at document generation. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Adding Calculated Variables**
New mechanism to define "formula" variables representing arithmetic operations between numeric fields and constants, resolved at document generation time. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Adding TODAY() Variable**
First supported system variable; resolves to the current date at document generation time rather than from a data source. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **WAI: Add a Settings Tab**
New Settings tab lets template creators configure signer behavior, document expiration settings, and naming conventions for templates containing Signature Fields. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Adding Sorted Option for Lists**
The Word Add-in list insertion flow now supports optional sorting (ascending or descending) instead of always using the data source's default order. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Merge PDF Files on Download**
A new merged format option on the download endpoint allows multiple PDF documents to be merged into a single consolidated PDF file, returned as a direct download. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/41357904174743) | **Merge DOCX Files on Download**
